dnsAction: Keep or attach this hostname as the Custom Domain of the existing site worker. Cloudflare manages its DNS record and HTTPS certificate.
rootCname: Keep CNAME file at repository root set to andrewr.online.
doNotCreate: A CNAME with a URL path, a second CNAME inside arrangemasterpro/, or a redirect from the public subdomain to the GitHub directory.
prerequisite: Publish the local arrangemasterpro directory through GitHub Pages and pass verify-origin.mjs before deploying the proxy worker.
